In the United States, a SWAT (special weapons and tactics) team is generic term for a law enforcement unit that uses specialized or military equipment and tactics. Although they were first created in the 1960s to handle riot control or violent confrontations with criminals, the number and usage of SWAT teams increased in the 1980s and 1990s during the War on Drugs and later in the aftermath of the September 11 attacks. In the United States as of 2005, SWAT teams were deployed 50,000 times every year, almost 80% of the time to serve search warrants, most often for narcotics.

results.name: Sci-Fi Soldier / Futuristic Combat Trooper
results.description:
This is a high-quality 3D model of a sci-fi combat soldier, fully equipped with futuristic tactical gear and detailed armor. Featuring PBR textures, realistic material definition, and advanced hard-surface design, this character is perfect for use in games, cinematics, or concept art.

The model includes a detailed helmet with sensors and antenna, modular armor plates, and a full-body tactical outfit with tech-enhanced details. Inspired by a mix of military realism and science fiction, this trooper could fit into a near-future battlefield or a galactic conflict.

🛠️ Features:

Fully textured with PBR maps (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, etc.)

Game-ready topology

Realistic sci-fi gear: helmet, radio module, utility vest, leg armor

Rigged and posed in T-pose (if applicable)

Ideal for FPS games, cinematic cutscenes, or VR environments

🎮 Recommended For:
Sci-fi shooters, strategy games, VR training simulations, or cinematic animation projects.

results.name: WW2 Panzergrenadier 2k (CC0)
results.description:
CC0
Free to use as you like unconditionaly.

The WW2 german panzergrenadiers were motorised units that often fought from armoured half tracks in various roles.

I put 100% into this character to practice and test my character creation and retopolgy skills, had to compress the textures to upload, but still looks good. All done in Blender 3.3 and GIMP and is based off the UE4 mannequin but with a smaller chest. The textures are 2k PBR and its 27k Triangles so should work well in game engines.

Also now rigged with mixamo rig, had to do it manually as it didn't work with the auto rigger and hopefully won't be to much work to use with the mixamo animations library.

I've started on an allied soldier aswell in the same style, so will post that when he's finished.

results.name: Free - Armor Plate Carrier - Gameready Metahuman
results.description:
Reupload: Deleted some faces on the magazine to reduce the triangle count from 34k to 24k making it lighter in game, also merged meshes as it would cause a crash when importing in UE5.

Military Tan plate Carrier I created using Blender and Subtance Painter.
I used a Subd workflow + a Multires/Clothes sculpting for the mesh, then baked it to a low poly version.
It comes with 3 sets of texture:
- Magazines
- Radio
- Plate Carrier

Each set contains:
- Base color
- Roughness map
- Normal map

The model is rigged to a metahuman skeleton and *should* be easy to import in unreal using the "Set Master Pose" component in a Blueprint.
This is free to use in games in Render,  credits are very appreciated.
I plan to model more military clothes in the future.

PS: I might add extra texture maps if requested in a zip (color id, ao, etc..)

Once again hope you enjoy this model :)
